title: Prescribed burning taking place on Friday
snippet: Weather and atmospheric conditions continue to be favorable for prescribed burning in many locations in Colorado on Friday. Several agencies intend to conduct burning operations. The image below, shows the CDPHE Prescribed Fire Map, which can be accessed through the tab at the top of this page. Map of planned prescribed burn locations in Colorado on Friday, 10/9/26.
